patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-resolution product imagery serves as background for text overlays and entire sections, creating an immersive visual experience.
Headings use a very large, thin sans-serif typeface, contrasting with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
A dark, moody palette dominates, featuring deep greens and charcoal greys, with white and light grey text providing strong contrast.

The initial hero section dynamically transforms on scroll: the main heading fades out, a 'Get in touch' section with a form slides in to replace it, and the background product image parallaxes smoothly upwards, revealing more of the vehicle.

Content is presented in distinct, vertically stacked full-width sections, often alternating between image-heavy backgrounds with text overlays and solid dark backgrounds with centered text blocks or grids.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger) to create a multi-layered parallax effect on background images while simultaneously transitioning foreground content. This includes elements fading in/out, sliding into view, and replacing previous content based on scroll depth.
The navigation bar starts transparent over the hero and then becomes sticky and gains a solid dark background as the user scrolls past the initial viewport.
Sections are revealed with subtle fade-up or slide-in animations as they enter the viewport, enhancing content discovery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, thin sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create a dramatic effect, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for subheadings and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks emphasizes individual elements and creates a premium feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly dynamic and seamless hero transformation. It masterfully transitions from a product showcase to a contact form on scroll, using multi-layered parallax and content replacement to create a truly engaging and premium user experience that feels both sophisticated and intuitive.
